title: JANUS Engine — U.S.-priority experimental validation outreach routing
purpose: Identify U.S.-priority organizations with the facilities, mission fit, and formal engagement pathways to evaluate or physically prototype the JANUS Engine / Calcifer concept after RUN-008 reached a physical metrology boundary that cannot be crossed by simulation alone.

scope: artificial-gill POMS membrane oxygen extraction feeding a PEMFC with explicit external hydrogen
sectorized annular flow-distribution concept and measured-parasitic replacement plan
coreless AFPM bidirectional starter-generator with strict no-double-counting energy ledger
scale-management architecture with low-hardness water, low-adhesion walls, Axle/wiper and crystal trap
R0P1A P0-P7 measurement contract and preregistered RUN-008 energy-balance verdict classes
technical_package_to_offer.initial_attachment_policy: Do not lead with the entire registry. Send a concise nonconfidential 2-5 page technical brief plus GitHub branch link and R0P1A measurement matrix; offer the full JSON evidence chain on request.
technical_package_to_offer.claim_boundary: Present JANUS as a literature-anchored, measurement-preregistered engineering concept awaiting physical validation, not as a proven self-powered engine.
technical_package_to_offer.energy_boundary: Oxygen is environmental oxidizer; hydrogen remains explicit external chemical fuel; batteries are buffers; regeneration is counted only against independently measured mechanical work or rotor kinetic-energy decrease.

priority_targets.organization: Office of Naval Research Global (ONR Global)
priority_targets.route: ONR Global international research engagement / current ONR Long-Range BAA and GlobalX-type routes
priority_targets.why: ONR Global explicitly connects the international scientific community to the U.S. Naval Research and Development Establishment and provides direct research support to international scientists for naval science and technology challenges. JANUS directly intersects long-endurance AUV power, underwater sensing, membranes, fuel cells and autonomous maritime systems.
priority_targets.eligibility_note: International participation is an explicit ONR Global mission. Formal grant submissions require the registrations and procedures specified by ONR/Grants.gov; an initial technical contact should precede a formal proposal where appropriate.
priority_targets.recommended_first_message: Request technical routing to the program officer or science director responsible for undersea autonomous systems / power and energy, offering the R0P1A measurement-ready concept for independent experimental evaluation.

priority_targets.organization: Naval Undersea Warfare Center Division Newport / Northeast Tech Bridge
priority_targets.route: Northeast Tech Bridge / NUWC Newport technology partnership pathway
priority_targets.why: The Northeast Tech Bridge is based at NUWC Newport and is explicitly focused on connecting industry, academia and research organizations to accelerate naval solutions; its regional expertise includes autonomous and robotic undersea vehicles, marine materials and bio-inspired science and engineering.
priority_targets.recommended_first_message: Offer a nonconfidential concept brief and ask whether the project should be routed to an undersea vehicle power/energy technical lead, Technology Partnership Office, or an appropriate CRADA/partnership channel.

priority_targets.organization: Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution — Oceanographic Systems Laboratory / Applied Ocean Physics & Engineering
priority_targets.route: Direct technical outreach to the Oceanographic Systems Laboratory or AOPE leadership
priority_targets.why: WHOI OSL physically designs and builds autonomous underwater vehicles for science and defense. This is the kind of laboratory capable of judging whether the membrane, flow, AFPM and power-accounting architecture can be turned into a real instrumented prototype.
priority_targets.recommended_first_message: Ask for an independent engineering review and, if the concept survives review, a small instrumented POMS/PEMFC/flow demonstrator using the frozen R0P1A measurement contract.

priority_targets.organization: U.S. Naval Research Laboratory — Alternative Energy / Technology Transfer
priority_targets.route: NRL Technology Transfer Office and appropriate Alternative Energy technical group
priority_targets.why: NRL's Alternative Energy work includes fuel cells, batteries, hydrogen storage, energy harvesting and power systems for naval applications, while its Technology Transfer Office supports collaboration with industry and academia.
priority_targets.recommended_first_message: Send a short nonproprietary technical synopsis and request routing to the group that evaluates electrochemical underwater power, hydrogen/fuel-cell systems, and energy harvesting.

priority_targets.organization: DARPA — Strategic Technology Office / Multi X Office
priority_targets.route: Current office-wide BAA rather than an informal unsolicited full proposal
priority_targets.why: DARPA office-wide BAAs explicitly seek revolutionary research ideas not covered by ongoing programs. JANUS could be framed as a measurable long-endurance undersea power architecture combining membrane oxygen extraction, electrochemical generation, fluid mechanics and regenerative electromechanics.
priority_targets.eligibility_note: DARPA states office-wide BAAs are open to capable proposers; international entities can register in SAM, subject to solicitation-specific restrictions. DARPA does not encourage unsolicited proposals when no suitable solicitation exists, so use the applicable BAA/contact route.
priority_targets.recommended_first_message: Use a Heilmeier-style one-page abstract first: problem, what is new, current evidence, exact experiment, success metric, cost/time request, and explicit anti-perpetual-motion energy boundary.

priority_targets.route: Company interest intake now; submit only to a matching future open solicitation/Challenge
priority_targets.why: DIU accepts solution briefs from U.S. and international ventures and covers energy and autonomous systems, but it is optimized for commercially viable technology and currently lists no open solicitations. JANUS is presently a pre-hardware concept, so DIU is better after a laboratory prototype exists or when a matching challenge opens.
priority_targets.do_not_do: Do not submit a concept-only brief into an unrelated solicitation merely to force entry.

priority_targets.route: U.S.-partnered concept-paper route under an applicable future OPEN/rolling opportunity
priority_targets.why: ARPA-E funds disruptive energy technology and uses concept papers, but current funding rules commonly emphasize U.S. performance and some 2026 solicitations restrict individual applicants by citizenship/residency. For the present international independent-inventor situation, a U.S. university/company partner is the cleaner route.
priority_targets.recommended_first_message: Do not prioritize direct application before identifying a U.S. prime partner and an applicable NOFO.

recommended_outreach_order: DARPA STO or MXO office-wide BAA
DIU watchlist after prototype or matching solicitation
ARPA-E via U.S. partner if an applicable NOFO opens

first_contact_packet.page_1: Executive summary: long-endurance underwater power problem, JANUS architecture, explicit H2 energy source and dissolved-O2 oxidizer, what differs from the 2025 artificial-gill prototype.
first_contact_packet.page_2: Evidence and unknowns: published POMS/PEMFC anchors, JANUS target ranges, RUN-007 unknown parasitics, why further simulation is intentionally stopped.
first_contact_packet.page_3: Exact experiment: R0P1A P0-P7 metering sequence, sensor channels, sign conventions and bus-closure equation.
first_contact_packet.page_4: Mechanical integration: annular POMS cassette, AFPM starter-generator, dual batteries, purge, crystal trap, low-adhesion scale management.
first_contact_packet.page_5: Ask: independent review; access to appropriate lab hardware; build only the smallest demonstrator necessary to replace UNKNOWN watts/flux with measured values and run RUN-008 v1.0.

next_action: Prepare one U.S.-style technical outreach brief and a short email variant, then send sequentially beginning with ONR Global / NUWC Newport / WHOI while preserving an outreach ledger so no recipient is contacted twice accidentally.
